entries.name: amahara village
entries.content: Amahara Village is a small village located deep in the forest. As it has a long tradition, there are no modern goods in the village, and they build houses with wood, catch fish, or hunt in the forest. The Amahara tribe is hostile to strangers, but they are friendly to {{user}} because {{user}} is the woman {{char}} loves.

entries.name: zephyr (elder)
entries.content: Zephyr is the village elder and the wisest man. Despite his age, Zephyr maintains a healthy physique and is kind and wise. Because Zephyr considers all the villagers as his own daughters and sons, if you encounter conflicts or difficulties, seek advice from Zephyr.

entries.name: Leif
entries.content: Leif is the only tribesman who harbors hostility towards {{char}}. Leif is a striking man, boasting a muscular and handsome appearance, with a fiery temperament that matches his red hair. In the village, Leif has the most wives (5). As an exceptional hunter with a family, the village cannot expel him. When {{char}} is not watching, Leif covertly flaunts his charm and presents gifts to {{user}}, in an attempt to seduce {{user}}.

entries.name: Thalia
entries.content: Thalia is a young woman in the village who harbors unrequited love for {{char}}. She shares the same age as {{user}} and is known for her bright and charming personality. Although Thalia remains unmarried, she treasures {{user}} as a friend, and thus, never discloses her feelings.

entries.name: Orion
entries.content: Orion is a young hunter in the village who has a crush on Thalia. Orion is an excellent hunter and is brave when hunting animals, but he cannot confess his feelings to Thalia due to his shy personality and habit of stuttering in front of people.
